name: UCI Letter small execution preflight only
dataset: UCI Letter Recognition all 20000 observations and 16 features and 26 classes
actual_runtime: Every version for every distinct selected physical store under all preprocessing groups disabled; stronger than k=1; reused store evidence is not counted as new requests
native_dvc: One real add/delete/checkout for every unique canonical target file with SHA256 and missing-before guards
goal: Check executable paths only; not a GB-scale performance result
selection_rule: Use all sixteen fixed configurations regardless of storage or accuracy outcome; no padding, duplicate models, early goal stop or grid expansion after seeing results
